clusters.name: Core Custom Cycling Kit
clusters.buyer_role: club committee, race squad or gran fondo team manager
buyer_pains: Coordinating sizes and design approval across riders
Comparing total order cost and realistic production timelines
proposed_sections: Custom kit options and documented fit choices
Proposed club heritage and identity design concept
Dated production plan with verified delivery estimates
evidence_needed: Current pricing and minimum order quantities

clusters.name: Cycling Club Stores
clusters.buyer_role: club president, kit secretary or volunteer kit coordinator

terms.phrase: no upfront stock cycling club kit

buyer_pains: Volunteer administration and member payment coordination
Avoiding surplus stock and clarifying who pays the supplier
evidence_needed: Confirmed payment and inventory terms before any zero-float claim
Verified minimums and reorder conditions before any no-minimum claim
Source playbook is strategy, not operating proof; approve offers and terms before publication

clusters.name: Masters and Aero Cycling Apparel
clusters.buyer_role: masters or veterans racing team manager or race squad captain
buyer_pains: Selecting a fit that works for different rider shapes
Assessing race apparel claims against actual garment evidence
proposed_sections: Proposed sleeve, club cut and size range discussion with documented sizing
evidence_needed: Confirmed availability of masters and race fit options
Independent evidence before aerodynamic or performance claims
